classification.specific_contribution: Bounded typed reconciliation of installed NASA cFS STD/EDS snapshots using frozen references and controlled negative cases.

references.boundary: Public normative context; no NASA compliance assessment or internal process inspection.
references.citation: NASA. Software Assurance and Software Safety Standard. NASA-STD-8739.8B, 2022.
references.en: Defines a lifecycle framework for software assurance, software safety and independent verification and validation.
references.pt: Define uma estrutura de ciclo de vida para garantia de software, segurança e verificação e validação independentes.

references.boundary: The present experiment is not a formal NASA configuration audit.
references.citation: NASA. Software Engineering Handbook, Revision D. SWE-084: Configuration Audits.
references.en: Configuration audits compare the actual configuration items with the records that define them.
references.pt: Auditorias de configuração confrontam os itens de configuração efetivos com os registros que os definem.

references.boundary: Different experimental targets and methodology; no comparative performance claim.
references.citation: Yu, S.; Song, W.; Hu, X.; Yin, H. On the Correctness of Metadata-Based SBOM Generation: A Differential Analysis Approach. IEEE/IFIP DSN, 2024.
references.en: A differential evaluation of four metadata-based SBOM generators found discrepancies and missing dependencies across 7,876 open-source projects.
references.pt: Uma avaliação diferencial de quatro geradores de SBOM baseados em metadados encontrou divergências e dependências ausentes em 7.876 projetos de código aberto.

references.boundary: Direct antecedent of inventory/artifact reconciliation; the cFS experiment uses installed-file identities, hashes and direct dynamic declarations.
references.citation: Xiao, Y.; Kirat, D.; Schales, D. L.; Jang, J.; Xing, L.; Liao, X. JBomAudit: Assessing the Landscape, Compliance, and Security Implications of Java SBOMs. NDSS, 2025.
references.en: JBomAudit evaluates declared dependencies against associated Java artifacts. Its study examined 25,882 SBOMs and associated JAR files and reported 7,907 SBOMs missing direct dependencies.
references.pt: O JBomAudit avalia dependências declaradas em relação aos artefatos Java associados. Seu estudo examinou 25.882 SBOMs e arquivos JAR associados e reportou 7.907 SBOMs com dependências diretas omitidas.

references.boundary: Representation and conformance do not alone establish correspondence with an installed snapshot.
references.citation: SPDX. SPDX Specification v2.3.1, Clause 7: Package information.
references.en: Specifies package identifiers and descriptive fields, including package-level integrity information.
references.pt: Especifica identificadores e campos descritivos de pacotes, incluindo informações de integridade no nível de pacote.

references.boundary: Expressible completeness claims are not automatically verified completeness of an observed installation.
references.citation: Ecma International. ECMA-424: CycloneDX Bill of Materials Specification. Second edition, December 2025; CycloneDX v1.7.
references.en: Provides structured representation of components, dependencies, compositions and supporting evidence.
references.pt: Oferece representação estruturada de componentes, dependências, composições e evidências de suporte.

references.boundary: Provenance does not by itself prove global composition completeness or runtime provider resolution.
references.en: Build provenance records production context, parameters, outputs and resolved dependencies when known.
references.pt: A proveniência de build registra contexto de produção, parâmetros, saídas e dependências resolvidas quando conhecidas.

references.boundary: Established antecedent of evidence-based acceptance; not an implementation dependency of this study.
references.en: Signed policies evaluate attestations, trusted signers, artifact consistency and policy conditions.
references.pt: Políticas assinadas avaliam atestações, signatários confiáveis, consistência de artefatos e condições de política.

references.boundary: Documentation only; no execution or benchmark.
references.en: Documents BOM validation, comparison, conversion and related operations.
references.pt: Documenta validação, comparação, conversão e operações relacionadas a BOMs.

references.boundary: Quality scoring is related but not equivalent to the specific frozen-reference experiment.
references.en: Documents SBOM quality scoring and compliance checks.
references.pt: Documenta pontuação de qualidade e verificações de conformidade de SBOMs.

references.boundary: Announcement verified; not a clause-level review of the complete guidance.
references.citation: CISA. CISA, U.S. Government and International Partners Release Updated Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials. 29 July 2026.
references.en: Announces updated SBOM guidance addressing component hashes and generation context among other fields.
references.pt: Anuncia orientações atualizadas de SBOM que abrangem hashes de componentes e contexto de geração, entre outros campos.
